title.en: A debut marathon winner and a one-second eighth title
title.zh: 首马夺冠，与一秒之差的第八冠

summary.en: Andreas Almgren won his first marathon in New York; Marcel Hug took an eighth wheelchair title by one second. The organizer reports nearly60,000 participants; final finisher totals remain pending.
summary.zh: Andreas Almgren在纽约首次参加全马即夺冠；Marcel Hug以一秒优势赢得第八次轮椅组冠军。主办方称参与者近六万，最终完赛人数仍待公布。

title.en: The quantum migration clock starts before the machine arrives
title.zh: 量子威胁到来之前，迁移时钟已经启动

summary.en: NIST’s October27final roadmap scopes federal post-quantum migration targets to2030/2031for priority systems and2035more broadly. Long-lived secrets create a present planning problem.
summary.zh: NIST于10月27日公布最终路线图，重点联邦系统对应2030／2031年迁移节点，较广范围目标为2035年；长期机密已带来当下的规划问题。
